title: Managed native compact state output v1
description: One JSON line per native state output when the Host enabled compact output with configure_output. Without that command the native candidate keeps today's full output unchanged. Structural shape only; the rules that a schema cannot express (inline, rename, delta membership, reconcile, divergence) are in README.md beside this file and are executable in python/tests/test_prewrite_wp0_contracts.py.

object_key.description: <native_ref>#<view>. The view names the position kind the old writer emitted the body at (hand, draw_pile, deck, relic, potion, enemy, orb, pet, map_point, reward, ...), because one native object can be written with different field sets at different positions.

object_body.description: Exactly the object the old full writer emits at that position, including its native_ref field when the old writer has one.

object_digests.description: sha256 of each body's exact UTF-8 bytes as written in this line (compact JSON, no insignificant whitespace). Computed from output bytes only, never from internal dirty flags.

start.description: How this episode instance began. S4 hook: from_save carries the loaded save's digest so initial progress is known from the first frame.

combat_end.description: Native fact written once when a combat ends, in the first frame after the end. Every field is visible to a player. Reward-only: not model input. Pending the Connector fair-projection review before any consumer uses it.

diagnostics.description: Optional counters for profiling. Never model input; never compared for equivalence.

episode_instance.description: New for every run in the process, including each in-process restart and each save load. Late messages keyed to an old instance are discarded.

skeleton.description: Today's full state tree with every table object replaced in place by {"$obj": key}. Always complete in every frame: decision kind, stage, option lists and their order, and every other field outside object bodies.

objects_root_sha256.description: sha256 over the lines "<key>\t<digest>\n" of the whole table after this frame, keys sorted by byte order.

full.description: Starts an episode instance (seq 0) or answers configure_output. Carries the whole table.

delta.description: objects holds only the upserted keys; removed lists keys no longer referenced by the skeleton.

reconcile.description: Once per reconcile_interval steps. objects holds the whole table; upserted and removed state what a delta frame would have said, so the Host can prove its carried table matches the full one.

configure_output.description: Host to native command. The reply is a full frame of the current state. Absent this command, output stays today's full format.
